items.title: Python Software Foundation - Python 3.11.0a3 to 3.15.0b2
items.summary: Bishop Fox discovered a privilege escalation vulnerability in Python for Windows affecting versions 3.11.0a3 through 3.15.0b2. A low-privilege user can plant malicious files and wait for a privileged account to run the interpreter, inheriting that account's elevated access. Patches are available.
